outputs.trial_table.csv: RAW; one row per trial with exposure, populations, outcomes (NaN outside each outcome's population)
outputs.exposure_summary.csv: per outcome × exposure; population per outcome as in summary.json['outcomes']
outputs.early_vs_late.csv: participants with values in exposures (1, 2, 3) and (7, 8, 9)
outputs.exposure_models.csv: primary outcomes; fitted only if exposure is separable from cell
outputs.multitor_sensitivity_t_button.csv: TOR_ANCHORED vs TOR_ANCHORED with a single raw TOR value
outputs.summary.json: machine-readable summary incl. definitions, windows, exclusions, limitations

known_semantic_limitations: B17: accelerator/brake/steering channels are not driver-only; no control-channel quantity is used
B7: Manual_Start is an event marker; authority transfer UNRESOLVED
B11: scenario cells are aliased with road, speed, hazard state, lane configuration and automation-transition behaviour; cells are controls, not factors of interest
Exposure is chronological trial position; carry-over from the specific preceding scenario is not separable
Any practice or familiarisation drives before the recorded trials are not in the public data
B12: the owners' 466-trial analysis set is not reconstructed
